title: 6sense Personalization for ABM Programs: How Folloze Activates Intent into Pipeline
thesis: 6sense personalization uses intent data to tailor experiences for target accounts, but speed is critical for outcomes. Folloze, as an AI orchestration platform, activates 6sense signals 50% faster, turning insights into dynamic campaigns that drive pipeline. According to a 2024 Gartner report, 75% of B2B buyers expect personalized content by the second interaction.
summary: 6sense personalization is the practice of using 6sense's intent, firmographic, and account data to deliver tailored content and experiences to specific buying groups. For ABM, this means moving beyond generic campaigns to create dynamic, relevant journeys for high-value accounts. When paired with an AI orchestration platform, this process transforms raw signals into measurable pipeline acceleration.
